layoutPatterns: Responsive Sidebar layout: hidden on mobile, slides in via hamburger menu drawer.
Multi-column Bento Grid layout for dashboard charts.
uxGuidelines: Maintain a clear information hierarchy: primary metrics must load at the top of the viewport.
Incorporate skeletal shimmer loading states to reduce user-perceived fetch latencies.

layoutPatterns: Fluid single-page layout separated by clean high-contrast spacing blocks.
Alternate visual grids: left-text right-image alternating cards.
uxGuidelines: Establish immediate visual focal points in the Hero segment with a strong call-to-action.
Avoid large layout shifts (CLS) on dynamic marquees and sliders.

layoutPatterns: Centered modal-style entry card layout with subtle obsidian backdrop-blurs.
Full-screen ambient neon halo background glow overlay.
uxGuidelines: Focus user input attention immediately by placing the cursor inside primary inputs upon mount.
Render descriptive interactive error warning tags directly next to invalid input fields.

layoutPatterns: Split-screen layout: left-side brand statement testimonial, right-side registration form wizard.
uxGuidelines: Divide lengthy input setups into clear progressive disclosure steps to avoid cognitive fatigue.
Preserve user inputs when navigating backward across step indicators.

requiredSections: Danger Zone account deletion warning card
layoutPatterns: Split vertical navigation sidebar structure on desktop, merging into responsive top menus on mobile viewports.
uxGuidelines: Provide immediate visual toast feedback messages upon configuration state saves.
Delineate dangerous delete buttons with high-contrast red warning borders.

requiredSections: User Profile Banner & Bio Card Header
layoutPatterns: Asymmetric two-column profile overview grid: narrow details sidebar panel, wide activity feed stream.
uxGuidelines: Enable instant in-place inline profile editing updates for user fields.
Apply smooth fading grid transitions on gallery filter category tabs.

layoutPatterns: Three-column subscription tier grid displaying the popular plan in the center column with ambient highlight glows.
uxGuidelines: Make plan comparison benefits extremely legible by using icons for included vs excluded items.
Use clear, direct billing terminology without hidden or ambiguous service charges.
